answer: One chip, one identity: a fresh attestation quote is required every 14 epochs and a chip caught signing for two keys burns both seats. Building 260 fake identities means buying 260 chips, each worth more than the epoch payout, while an honest agent uses the device it already has. What carries the horizon here is verification, the nectar of cost is what stops the farm, and the ledge of the record keeps every claim checkable.
